Stored same-operator host and container OpenSees values still pass current-product replay for one -0.1 mm settlement case, but the current-source external runtime rerun, independent Level 2/3 V&V, design authority, and release eligibility remain absent.
Internal dense augmented-Newton path with one free UX/UY control DOF.
Unified public J1-J5 exposure, native sparse execution, and external V&V remain open.

Bounded internal 3D graph candidate; the dense load-control solve uses shared source-bound 6DOF force/moment scaling with fail-closed real-binary64 source validation, residual-and-increment commit gates, strict scaled-residual-decreasing backtracking, final equilibrium reassembly, and parent-checkpoint immutability checks.
No independent external 3D comparison or release authority.

Two- or three-point axial-biaxial fiber integration over a bounded Timoshenko reference; native sparse load control uses model-bound 6DOF force/moment scaling, residual-and-increment commit gates, strict residual-decreasing backtracking, exact material-response accepted-parent hash binding, material-specific steel/concrete/bond-slip admissibility through nested states, binary64-exact checkpoint displacement identity, deterministic unloaded genesis plus non-genesis nonzero-parent invariants, checkpoint-displacement material-state replay, final equilibrium reassembly, fail-closed scaled factorization diagnostics, and explicitly convergence-classified adaptive load cutback with rejected-trial rollback and exact accepted-checkpoint resume. A zero-update child is valid only when a changed load acts on restrained equations and every replay, factorization, reassembly, and equilibrium gate passes.
Shear and torsion remain elastic; the separately registered direct-displacement-control candidate does not add arc-length, analytic 3D tangents, independent external 3D V&V, or release authority.

One free UX, UY, UZ, RX, RY, or RZ coordinate and one proportional reference-load factor are solved by a source-scaled sparse augmented Newton path with residual, increment, control, line-search, material-admissibility, final-reassembly, and factorization gates. Finite but constitutively unreachable bilinear-steel checkpoint states and target increments already inside the configured control tolerance fail before solving. Bounded adaptive target cutback retries only maximum-iteration or pure admissible merit-line-search failures, uses unit-specific minima plus depth/substep/whole-path attempt bounds, and hash-records every rejected target against an immutable accepted parent.

The direct-control Newton budget cannot exceed the sparse Frame3D budget bound into accepted checkpoints. Checkpoint converged_iterations counts applied Newton/line-search updates rather than the terminal gate-evaluation row, so bound-edge convergence remains self-validating. Terminal increment, load-increment, and condition scalars are unavailable when the terminal factorization fails; earlier successful diagnostics remain history only.

The bounded_frame3d_direct_displacement_control ModelIR v2 profile and candidate Python API expose source-bound zero-offset/unreleased graphs, binary64-exact projected coordinates/properties/loads, explicit bilinear steel/shear modulus, free-equation reference loads, ordered node/member/material recovery, and exact-resume artifacts while keeping capability-registry public=false. Persisted checkpoints require a deterministic unloaded genesis plus non-genesis nonzero-parent invariants, complete ordered recovery identities, finite repository-canonical JSON bytes, and raw-to-typed checkpoint/resume-binding/top-level-envelope numeric identity. A zero-update child is permitted only for a changed load confined to restrained equations after all replay, factorization, reassembly, and equilibrium gates pass. Default monotonic paths retain the v1 direction binding; opt-in reversal is limited to exact bilinear combined-hardening steel and uses a v2 last-leg/cumulative-count/rolling-target-chain binding whose completed-target count cannot exceed the accepted step index. The unsigned hashes provide internal consistency, not authentication against complete rehashing. Same-operator OpenSees 3D forceBeamColumn comparisons cover one monotonic axial-yield UX path, one five-target axial reversal path against the exact Hardening law, and pure-axis elastic RX, RY, and RZ paths. Coupled MY+MZ probing exposes formulation-dependent second-order torsional coupling and is not promoted; other cyclic histories/materials, coupled multi-axis or multi-control behavior, general material/shear/torsion coupling, and independent V&V remain open. A bare internal checkpoint is an unbound restart and an incomplete intermediate cutback checkpoint is not exact continuation. Prescribed supports, offsets/releases, arc-length continuation, Workbench execution, independent direct-control 3D V&V, design authority, and release authority remain unsupported.
Monotonic uniaxial compression envelope only. Stateful unloading, reversal, tension, and cyclic trials fail closed with unsupported_constitutive_path.
Ultimate-strain exceedance emits confined_concrete_crushing_event instead of silently entering the discontinuous residual cutoff in solver execution.
Multiaxial behavior, localization regularization, published calibration, and release authority remain unsupported.
Bounded SI-unit connector material point.
Connector groups, published calibration, independent V&V, and release authority remain open.
Condensed single-slip-mode axial member coupling.
General shear lag, uplift/contact, connector groups, and external V&V remain open.
Fail-closed Newmark average-acceleration bilinear SDOF reference kernel.
Detached checkpoints have self-consistency authority only; resume requires a genesis-rooted source-authenticated force-history chain with full Newmark and work/dissipation replay.
MDOF nonlinear dynamics, general hysteretic materials, external V&V, and release authority remain open.
